#this code matches the MCI and DOC causes of death to the template by matching cause with COD "manner" and specific cause information (illness, drug, homicide, suicide, etc.) with COD "cause"

looking at both cause_of_death and specific variables to see where missingness may lie
```{r counting}
str(combined$cause_of_death) #character
str(combined$illspec) #charaacter

combined <- combined %>%mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "")))

combined%>%filter(is.na(cause_of_death))%>%count() #7688



combined %>%
  filter(
    (is.na(illspec)   | illspec == "") &
    (is.na(drugspec)  | drugspec == "") &
    (is.na(selfspec)  | selfspec == "") &
    (is.na(accspec)   | accspec == "") &
    (is.na(suicspec)  | suicspec == "") &
    (is.na(homispec)  | homispec == "") &
    (is.na(otherspec) | otherspec == "")
  ) %>%
  count()

#34487

combined %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cause_of_death),
    cause_of_death != "",
    if_any(
      c(illspec, drugspec, selfspec, accspec,
        suicspec, homispec, otherspec),
      ~ !is.na(.) & . != ""
    )
  ) %>%
  count() #15196 are captured in this 
```


fitting combined into template 1 where manner = COD general and cause= COD specific 
```{r fitting}
template1 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = X,
    MANNER = cause_of_death,

   CAUSE = coalesce(
      illspec,
      drugspec,
      homispec,
      suicspec,
      selfspec,
      accspec,
      otherspec
    )
  )

template1 %>%summarise(n_missing = sum(is.na(MANNER) | MANNER == "")) #7688
template1 %>%summarise(n_missing = sum(is.na(CAUSE) | CAUSE == "")) #34487 

write_xlsx(template1, "fitting_mci_doc_cod/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx")
```

```{python template1}
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'natural', 'NATURAL'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'SUICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'unknown', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'undetermined', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'pending', 'PENDING'] = True

        print(df[['MANNER','ACCIDENT','NATURAL','HOMICIDE','SUICIDE','UNKNOWN']])

        print('exception')

        #for elem in heat_keywords:
            #print(elem)
       
        #Cold keywords list
        cold_keywords = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords')['COLD KEYWORDS'].tolist()
        # Remove all occurrences of 'nan' from the list
        cold_keywords = [x for x in cold_keywords if not pd.isna(x)]
        #for elem in cold_keywords:
            #print(elem)

        #Injury keywords list
        inj_keywords = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords')['INJURY KEYWORDS'].tolist()
        #Remove all occurrences of 'nan' from the list

        #for elem in inj_keywords:
            #print(elem)        

        #Heart keywords list

        #for elem in heart_keywords:
            #print(elem)

        #Illness keywords list   
        illness_keywords = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords', engine='openpyxl')['ILLNESS KEYWORDS'].tolist()
        # Remove all occurrences of 'nan' from the list
        illness_keywords = [x for x in illness_keywords if not pd.isna(x)]
        #for elem in illness_keywords:
            #print(elem)

        #Undetermined keywords list   
        undetermined_keywords = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords', engine='openpyxl')['UNDETERMINED'].tolist()
        # Remove all occurrences of 'nan' from the list
        undetermined_keywords = [x for x in undetermined_keywords if not pd.isna(x)]
        #for elem in undetermined_keywords:
            #print(elem)

        #Firearm keywords list   
        firearm_keywords = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords', engine='openpyxl')['FIREARM'].tolist()
        # Remove all occurrences of 'nan' from the list
        firearm_keywords = [x for x in firearm_keywords if not pd.isna(x)]
        for elem in firearm_keywords:
            print(elem)

        #USE ANOTHER ITERATION OF THE CODE IN THIS SECTION TO READ IN THE SUDORS KEYWORDS IF DESIRED
        
    except:
        print('exception')

   #Preliminary cause assignments. 
    try:
        
        #Clean cause strings, strip of preceding/following spaces and capitalize to match kw
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].str.strip().str.upper()
        #print(df['CAUSE'])
        
        #Initialize preliminary cause columns
        df['PRELIM_OD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEAT'] = False
        df['PRELIM_COLD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEART'] = False
        df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['PRELIM_FIREARM'] = False

        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = True
        #print(df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'])

        #Suicide, only need to check if the manner = suicide
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = True
        #print(df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'])

        for kw in heart_keywords:

        #print(df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'])

        #Firearm
        for kw in firearm_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw), 'PRELIM_FIREARM'] = True
        #print(df['PRELIM_FIREARM'])

        #Unknown
        for kw in undetermined_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw), 'PRELIM_UNKNOWN'] = True
        #print(df['PRELIM_UNKNOWN'])
            
        print(df)
            

    except:
            print('exception')

    #Applying logic and context of Manner to assign records final causes of death
    try:
        #Initialize final columns
        df['FINAL_ACC_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_ALL_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD_UNK'] = False

        df.loc[df['ACCIDENT'] & df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_ACC_OD'] = True
        print(df['FINAL_ACC_OD'])

        #Final ALL Overdose count, includes overdoses of accidental, homicidal, suicidal, and undetermined manner
        #Specifically excludes natural manner deaths as Overdose is not a natural death
        df.loc[~df['NATURAL'] & df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_ALL_OD'] = True

        #Final heat (accident only)
        df.loc[df['ACCIDENT'] & df['PRELIM_HEAT'] & ~df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_HEAT'] = True
        print(df['FINAL_HEAT'])

        #Final heat ALLOW UNKNOWN
        df.loc[(df['ACCIDENT'] | df['UNKNOWN']) & df['PRELIM_HEAT'] & ~df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] = True

        #Final Cold (accident only)
        df.loc[df['ACCIDENT'] & df['PRELIM_COLD'] & ~df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_COLD'] = True

        #Final cold ALLOW UNKNOWN
        df.loc[(df['ACCIDENT'] | df['UNKNOWN']) & df['PRELIM_COLD'] & ~df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_COLD_UNK'] = True

        #Final other injury
        df.loc[df['ACCIDENT'] & df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] & ~df['PRELIM_OD'] & ~df['PRELIM_COLD'] & ~df['PRELIM_HEAT'], 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = True

        #Final other injury ALLOW UNKNOWN MANNER
        df.loc[(df['ACCIDENT'] | df['UNKNOWN']) & df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY' ] & ~df['PRELIM_OD'] & ~df['PRELIM_COLD'] & ~df['PRELIM_HEAT'], 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] = True

        #Final homicide
        df.loc[df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'], 'FINAL_HOMICIDE'] = True
        print(df['FINAL_HOMICIDE'])

        #Final Suicide
        df.loc[df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'], 'FINAL_SUICIDE'] = True
        print(df['FINAL_SUICIDE'])

        #Final Heart
        df.loc[df['NATURAL'] & df['PRELIM_HEART'], 'FINAL_HEART'] = True

        #Final Heart ALLOW UNKNOWN
        df.loc[(df['NATURAL'] | df['UNKNOWN']) & df['PRELIM_HEART'], 'FINAL_HEART_UNK'] = True

        #Final Illness
        df.loc[df['NATURAL'] & df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'] & ~df['PRELIM_HEART'], 'FINAL_ILLNESS'] = True

        #Final Illness ALLOW UNKNOWN
        df.loc[(df['NATURAL'] | df['UNKNOWN']) & df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'] & ~df['PRELIM_HEART'], 'FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'] = True

        #Final Undetermined
        df.loc[df['UNKNOWN'], 'FINAL_UNKNOWN'] = True
        print(df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'])

        #Final Undetermined when undetermined manner is allowed to be coded
        df.loc[df['UNKNOWN'] & ~df['PRELIM_OD'] & ~df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] & ~df['FINAL_HEART_UNK'] & ~df['FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'], 'FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'] = True

        #For manual output
df.loc[
    ~df['FINAL_ACC_OD'] &
    ~df['FINAL_ALL_OD'] &
    ~df['FINAL_HEAT'] &
    ~df['FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] &

    ~df['FINAL_HEART'] &
    ~df['FINAL_HEART_UNK'] &
    ~df['FINAL_ILLNESS'] &
    ~df['FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'] &
    ~df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'] &
    ~df['FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'],
    'MANUAL'
] = True      
      
      
        #df filtered for manual output
        manaual_df = df[df['MANUAL'] == True ]
        print(manaual_df)

    except:
        print('exception')

    #Assign values for mutually exclusive coding schema
    try:

        #initialize COD column
        df['COD'] = 0

        #Overdose = 1
        df.loc[df['FINAL_ACC_OD'], 'COD'] = 1

        #Heat = 2
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEAT'], 'COD'] = 2

        #Cold = 3
        df.loc[df['FINAL_COLD'], 'COD'] = 3

        #Other Injury = 4
        df.loc[df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'], 'COD'] = 4

        #Homicide = 5
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HOMICIDE'], 'COD'] = 5

        #Suicide = 6
        df.loc[df['FINAL_SUICIDE'], 'COD'] = 6

        #Heart = 7
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEART'], 'COD'] = 7

        #Illness = 8
        df.loc[df['FINAL_ILLNESS'], 'COD'] = 8

        #Unknown = 9
        df.loc[df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'], 'COD'] = 9

        #Need to be manually coded = 0
        df.loc[df['MANUAL'], 'COD'] = 0

        print(df.head)

    except:
        print('exception')

    #export the full dataframe to an excel sheet
    try:
        df.to_excel('final_cod_output_1.xlsx', index = False)
    
    except:
        print('exception')
```

this section runs template 1 through the edited keywords list
```{python edited}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from numpy import isnan
import math as math
import csv

# Constants
excel_file_name = 'COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx'
sub_sheet = 'Sheet1'
keywords_excel = 'final_kw_v1.xlsx'
kw_sub_sheet = 'keywords_additional'


if __name__ == "__main__":

    try:
        df = pd.read_excel(excel_file_name, sheet_name=sub_sheet, engine='openpyxl')

        df['MANNER'] = df['MANNER'].fillna("").str.strip().str.lower()
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").str.strip().str.lower()

        df['ACCIDENT'] = False
        df['NATURAL'] = False
        df['HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['SUICIDE'] = False
        df['UNKNOWN'] = False
        df['PENDING'] = False

        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'accident', 'ACCIDENT'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'natural', 'NATURAL'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'SUICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'unknown', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'undetermined', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'pending', 'PENDING'] = True

    except:
        print('exception')


    try:
        kw_df = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords_additional', engine='openpyxl')

        od_keywords = kw_df['OVERDOSE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        heat_keywords = kw_df['HEAT KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        cold_keywords = kw_df['COLD KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        inj_keywords = kw_df['INJURY KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        heart_keywords = kw_df['HEART KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        illness_keywords = kw_df['ILLNESS KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        undetermined_keywords = kw_df['UNDETERMINED'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        firearm_keywords = kw_df['FIREARM'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()

    except:
        print('exception')


    try:
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").str.upper()

        df['PRELIM_OD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEAT'] = False
        df['PRELIM_COLD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEART'] = False
        df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['PRELIM_FIREARM'] = False
        df['PRELIM_UNKNOWN'] = False

        for kw in od_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_OD'] = True

        for kw in heat_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_HEAT'] = True

        for kw in cold_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_COLD'] = True

        for kw in inj_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] = True

        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = True

        for kw in heart_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_HEART'] = True

        for kw in illness_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_ILLNESS'] = True

        for kw in firearm_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_FIREARM'] = True

        for kw in undetermined_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_UNKNOWN'] = True

    except:
        print('exception')


    try:

        df['FINAL_ACC_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_ALL_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['FINAL_SUICIDE'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'] = False
        df['MANUAL'] = False

        accident = df['ACCIDENT'].fillna(False)
        natural = df['NATURAL'].fillna(False)
        unknown = df['UNKNOWN'].fillna(False)

        prelim_od = df['PRELIM_OD'].fillna(False)
        prelim_heat = df['PRELIM_HEAT'].fillna(False)
        prelim_cold = df['PRELIM_COLD'].fillna(False)
        prelim_other = df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'].fillna(False)
        prelim_heart = df['PRELIM_HEART'].fillna(False)
        prelim_illness = df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'].fillna(False)
        prelim_homicide = df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'].fillna(False)
        prelim_suicide = df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'].fillna(False)

        df.loc[accident & prelim_od, 'FINAL_ACC_OD'] = True
        df.loc[~natural & prelim_od, 'FINAL_ALL_OD'] = True

        df.loc[accident & prelim_heat, 'FINAL_HEAT'] = True
        df.loc[(accident | unknown) & prelim_heat, 'FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[accident & prelim_cold, 'FINAL_COLD'] = True
        df.loc[(accident | unknown) & prelim_cold, 'FINAL_COLD_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[accident & prelim_other, 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = True
        df.loc[(accident | unknown) & prelim_other, 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[prelim_homicide, 'FINAL_HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[prelim_suicide, 'FINAL_SUICIDE'] = True

        df.loc[natural & prelim_heart, 'FINAL_HEART'] = True
        df.loc[(natural | unknown) & prelim_heart, 'FINAL_HEART_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[natural & prelim_illness & ~prelim_heart, 'FINAL_ILLNESS'] = True
        df.loc[(natural | unknown) & prelim_illness & ~prelim_heart, 'FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[unknown, 'FINAL_UNKNOWN'] = True

        df.loc[
            unknown &
            ~prelim_od &
            ~df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] &
            ~df['FINAL_HEART_UNK'] &
            ~df['FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'],
            'FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'
        ] = True

    

        final_cols = [
            'FINAL_ACC_OD','FINAL_ALL_OD','FINAL_HEAT','FINAL_HEAT_UNK',
            'FINAL_COLD','FINAL_COLD_UNK',
            'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY','FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK',
            'FINAL_HOMICIDE','FINAL_SUICIDE',
            'FINAL_HEART','FINAL_HEART_UNK',
            'FINAL_ILLNESS','FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK',
            'FINAL_UNKNOWN','FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'
        ]

        df['MANUAL'] = ~df[final_cols].fillna(False).any(axis=1)

        manual_df = df[df['MANUAL']]
        print(manual_df)

    except Exception as e:
        print('exception', e)


    try:
        df['COD'] = 0

        df.loc[df['FINAL_ACC_OD'], 'COD'] = 1
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEAT'], 'COD'] = 2
        df.loc[df['FINAL_COLD'], 'COD'] = 3
        df.loc[df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'], 'COD'] = 4
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HOMICIDE'], 'COD'] = 5
        df.loc[df['FINAL_SUICIDE'], 'COD'] = 6
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEART'], 'COD'] = 7
        df.loc[df['FINAL_ILLNESS'], 'COD'] = 8
        df.loc[df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'], 'COD'] = 9
        df.loc[df['MANUAL'], 'COD'] = 0

    except:
        print('exception')


    # SAVE
    df.to_excel('final_cod_output_1_edited.xlsx', index=False)
```

```{r onlycause}

  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = X,

   CAUSE = cause_of_death)
  
write_xlsx(template4, "fitting_mci_doc_cod/test_combinations/COD Coding Input template_4.xlsx")
```

in this step, I processed template 4 through python 
```{python template4}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from numpy import isnan
import math as math
import csv

# Constants
# MEO Entries
excel_file_name = 'fitting_mci_doc_cod/test_combinations/COD Coding Input template_4.xlsx'
sub_sheet = 'Sheet1'
# Keywords
keywords_excel = 'final_kw_v1.xlsx'
kw_sub_sheet = 'keywords'


# When ran
if __name__ == "__main__":
    
    # Initialize df outside the blocks so it's visible globally for saving
    df = None

    # --- BLOCK 1: Coding Manners into T/F ---
    try:    
        # Read excel file using pandas
        df = pd.read_excel(excel_file_name, sheet_name=sub_sheet, engine='openpyxl')
        
        # ACCOUNT FOR NAs: Fill missing values with empty text strings
        df['MANNER'] = df['MANNER'].fillna("").astype(str)
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").astype(str)
        
        # Strip and lowercase Manner and Cause columns
        df['MANNER'] = df['MANNER'].str.strip().str.lower()
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].str.strip().str.lower()

        # Initialize manner columns
        df['ACCIDENT'] = False
        df['NATURAL'] = False
        df['HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['SUICIDE'] = False
        df['UNKNOWN'] = False
        df['PENDING'] = False

        # Check for where manner matches
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'accident', 'ACCIDENT'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'natural', 'NATURAL'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'SUICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'unknown', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'undetermined', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'pending', 'PENDING'] = True

        print("--- MANNER MAPPING PREVIEW ---")
        print(df[['MANNER','ACCIDENT','NATURAL','HOMICIDE','SUICIDE','UNKNOWN']].head())  
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Exception in Manner block: {e}")

    # --- BLOCK 2: Keywords list building ---
    try:
        # Read codebook and convert any blank structure cells to NaNs for clean dropping
        kw_df = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords', engine='openpyxl')

        # Overdose keywords list
        od_keywords = kw_df['OVERDOSE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        od_keywords = [x for x in od_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']

        # Heat keywords list
        heat_keywords = kw_df['HEAT KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        heat_keywords = [x for x in heat_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']
       
        # Cold keywords list
        cold_keywords = kw_df['COLD KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        cold_keywords = [x for x in cold_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']

        # Injury keywords list
        inj_keywords = kw_df['INJURY KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        inj_keywords = [x for x in inj_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']       

        # Heart keywords list   
        heart_keywords = kw_df['HEART KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        heart_keywords = [x for x in heart_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']

        # Illness keywords list   
        illness_keywords = kw_df['ILLNESS KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        illness_keywords = [x for x in illness_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']

        # Undetermined keywords list   
        undetermined_keywords = kw_df['UNDETERMINED'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        undetermined_keywords = [x for x in undetermined_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']

        # Firearm keywords list   
        firearm_keywords = kw_df['FIREARM'].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        firearm_keywords = [x for x in firearm_keywords if x != "" and x != 'nan']
        
        print("\n--- KEYWORDS LOADED SUCCESSFULLY ---")
        print(f"Firearm keywords found: {len(firearm_keywords)}")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Exception in Keywords block: {e}")

   # --- BLOCK 3: Preliminary cause assignments ---
    try:
        # ACCOUNT FOR NAs: Re-verify that cause fields contain text, not missing values
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").astype(str)
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].str.strip().str.upper()
        
        # Initialize preliminary cause columns
        df['PRELIM_OD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEAT'] = False
        df['PRELIM_COLD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEART'] = False
        df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['PRELIM_FIREARM'] = False
        df['PRELIM_UNKNOWN'] = False

        # Overdose
        for kw in od_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_OD'] = True

        # Heat
        for kw in heat_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_HEAT'] = True
            
        # Cold
        for kw in cold_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_COLD'] = True

        # Other Injury
        for kw in inj_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] = True

        # Homicide, only need to check if the manner = homicide
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = True

        # Suicide, only need to check if the manner = suicide
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = True

        # Heart
        for kw in heart_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_HEART'] = True

        # Illness
        for kw in illness_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_ILLNESS'] = True

        # Firearm
        for kw in firearm_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_FIREARM'] = True

        # Unknown
        for kw in undetermined_keywords:
            if pd.isna(kw) or kw == "": continue
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_UNKNOWN'] = True
            
        print("\n--- PRELIMINARY COD ASSIGNMENTS COMPLETE ---")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Exception in Cause Assignment block: {e}")

    # --- BLOCK 4: Applying logic and context of Manner for Final Causes ---
    try:
        # Initialize final columns
        df['FINAL_ACC_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_ALL_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['FINAL_SUICIDE'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'] = False
        df['MANUAL'] = False

        # Final UNINTENTIONAL overdose (only includes only overdoses with accidental manner)
        df.loc[df['ACCIDENT'] & df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_ACC_OD'] = True

        # Final ALL Overdose count, includes overdoses of accidental, homicidal, suicidal, and undetermined manner
        # Specifically excludes natural manner deaths as Overdose is not a natural death
        df.loc[~df['NATURAL'] & df['PRELIM_OD'], 'FINAL_ALL_OD'] = True

        # Final heat (accident only)
        df.loc[df['ACCIDENT'] & df['PRELIM_HEAT'], 'FINAL_HEAT'] = True
        
        print("\n--- FINAL CLASSIFICATION COMPLETE ---")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Exception in Final Logic block: {e}")

    # --- FORCED SAVE OUTSIDE OF ALL TRY/EXCEPT BLOCKS ---
    if df is not None:
        output_file = 'fitting_mci_doc_cod/test_combinations/final_cod_output_4.xlsx'
        df.to_excel(output_file, index=False)
        print(f"\nSUCCESS: File forcefully saved to '{fitting_mci_doc_cod/test_combinations/final_cod_output_4.xlsx}'!")
    else:
        print("\nERROR: DataFrame could not be created; file was not saved.")
```
